race.comment: Looks a lovely race for EDUCATED (7) to notch up another win. She's just found one better in two starts this time in, excuses fresh before just missing as a $1.60 chance at Sandown Hillside. Back a notch here and freshened up, she should take beating. YOLO (11) has won two on the bounce over 1000m at Ballarat, too good under 60.5kg in a BM66 last time out. He'll need a touch of luck from the inside but can win again. INTEREST POINT (8) has been about the mark in two runs back and should be thereabouts. ELECTRIC ELVIS (18) continues to race very well. Off a let up here but warrants respect again.
